## Shrinkage by direction

- TODO: framing: every regularised transfer applies a shrinkage operator to the donor effect before transferring it.

| Method | Acts on $q_p$ | Degrees of freedom |
|---|---|---|
| direct transfer | nothing ($a = 1$) | 0 |
| scalar scale | all directions by one factor $a$ | 1 |
| PCA truncation | keeps the top $k$ directions | $k$ |
| spectral shrinkage | direction $j$ by $s_j / (s_j + n_j)$ | $k$ |
| reduced-rank regression | learned $k \times k$ map between subspaces | $k^2$ (H1-calibrated) |

## Fitting a scale

- TODO: model $\hat y_p = a\,q_p$, $a$ by least squares on training targets (five fixed target folds), scored on held-out targets.
- TODO: two definitions of $a$: effect space (E, closed form) and fold-change space (F, $\hat x_p = (x_0 + c)\,e^{a\,d_p} - c$, which generates counts). They agree.
- TODO: prediction first, the bound:
$$\frac{\lVert aQ - Y\rVert^2}{\lVert Y\rVert^2} = 1 - 2a\frac{\langle Q, Y\rangle}{\lVert Y\rVert^2} + a^2\frac{\lVert Q\rVert^2}{\lVert Y\rVert^2}, \qquad a^\star = \rho\,\frac{\lVert Y\rVert}{\lVert Q\rVert}, \qquad \min = 1 - \rho^2$$
  - retrieval and cosine are invariant to $a > 0$;
  - with $\rho \approx 0.07$–$0.10$, the best achievable MSE ratio is about 0.99.
- Results (five-source panel, $c = 1$, held out):

| Source | Fitted $a$ | MSE ratio [95%] |
|---|---:|---|
| K562 GWPS | 0.043 | 0.993 [0.988, 1.000] |
| KOLF2.1J | 0.046 | 0.991 [0.986, 0.997] |
| CD4+ T | 0.065 | 0.994 [0.987, 1.001] |
| HCT116 | 0.021 | 0.998 [0.996, 1.001] |
| HEK293T | 0.021 | 0.999 [0.998, 1.001] |

- TODO: an $a$ of about 0.05 is mostly noise shrinkage ($a^\star = \rho \times$ norm ratio), not biological attenuation.
- TODO: zero-shot alternative: $a$ fitted donor-to-donor (leave-one-source-out median about 0.08) vs. H1-fitted 0.136 for the average.
